newsitem.title: USA: Information Res reorganizes German venture.
newsitem.headline: Information Res reorganizes German venture.

text.p: Information Resources Inc said Thursday it has reorganized its joint venture in Germany with GfK AG, taking a 51 percent stake in the retail tracking business owned by the two firms.
Previously, GfK held an 85 percent stake in the company, while IRI held 15 percent.

The change creates a new company, IRI/GfK Retail Services, that will own and run the retail tracking and related software businesses previously operated by GfK Panel Services, Information Resources said.

Gfk AG will hold a 49 percent interest in the new entity, the company said. It will also become the 100 percent owner of Gfk Panel Services, which will continue to offer consumer panel and other services, Information Resources said.
